pages.title: Maned Wolf
pages.text: The maned wolf ($(o)Chrysocyon brachyurus$()) is a canid of the grasslands and scrub savannas of central South America.$(br2)Despite its name, it is neither a wolf nor a fox. It is the tallest wild canid, with very long legs, a red coat and a black mane along its neck.$(br2)Maned wolves are solitary omnivores; much of their diet is fruit, especially the wolf apple.
